title: Python micro-version pins must move together across setup-python action, companion fixtures, and version assertions
answers: setup-python pinned Python version no longer matches the runner cache
model serving test environment recreation fails after bumping Python patch version
how do I bump the pinned Python 3.10 or 3.11 patch version in CI
body:
Symptom: CI jobs select a Python patch version that the hosted runner cache does not have, or model-serving/virtualenv tests fail because a fixture still records the old Python version.
Root cause: the pinned micro version lives in several places: the per-OS selection block in .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml (python_version=...), the fixture files tests/resources/example_mlflow_1x_sklearn_model/{MLmodel,conda.yaml,python_env.yaml}, tests/resources/example_virtualenv_*/{conda.yaml,python_env.yaml,entrypoint.py}, and the inline YAML in tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py:test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0.
Fix pattern: when a Python pin changes, update the setup-python selection block and every companion fixture and version assertion in the same change (the PR did this for 3.10.20->3.10.21 and 3.11.15->3.11.16), so the entrypoint.py sys.version_info asserts match the new pin.
Constraints: the pins should match what the hosted runner caches provide (cited in the PR as the runner-images Readme manifests); bumping only the action or only the fixtures leaves tests asserting a version CI does not run. Follows the approach in #23684.
applies: Applies to Python version pins in the composite setup-python action and the test fixtures that record them; not to project dependency pins in pyproject.toml.
says: Continuous integration builds fail because the hosted runner cache lacks the requested Python release.
Model serving and virtual environment tests fail after updating the Python patch version.
Test assertions fail because example model environment fixtures still expect the previous Python version.
Ensure test fixtures and runner setup upgrade to the identical Python micro version simultaneously.
search: Pinned Python micro versions in .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml:python_version must be updated in the same change as companion test fixtures and version assertions. Affected locations include fixtures in tests/resources/example_mlflow_1x_sklearn_model/, tests/resources/example_virtualenv_*/, and inline YAML assertions in tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py:test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0. Version pins must align with hosted runner cache manifests, and the requirement applies to setup-python and test fixtures rather than project dependency pins in pyproject.toml.
